turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Um, well, what really brought me in is that my mind just won’t stay on one thing anymore. It's been pretty frustrating. 

I'm a jeweler, and lately when I'm at the bench, I just... I jump around too much. I'll go from reading a customer email to looking at a saw mark on a piece of metal, and then a noise outside catches my attention. Next thing I know, I realize I’ve completely lost the whole work order I was supposed to be doing. I just can't seem to keep my focus.
